Update for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric). **Now for Windows and macOS too.**

### New

- **Works on Windows 10 and 11.** The mod reads the media controls that pop up when you press a media key, so Spotify, Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Media Player, Apple Music and most other players work. Nothing extra to install. On Windows, **Music → Player** lists Windows players. If your player isn't found, see [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/arbelonson-source/belis-skylyrics/blob/main/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md#on-windows).
- **Works on macOS with Spotify and Apple Music.** A Mac doesn't tell other apps what's playing, so the mod asks the Spotify and Music apps directly, while they are open. Browsers and other players can't be seen on a Mac. The first time, macOS asks whether Minecraft may control them: click **OK**. If you clicked Don't Allow, see [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/arbelonson-source/belis-skylyrics/blob/main/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md#on-macos).
- **Handwritten letters** for the sky lyrics. **Look → Font** now has three choices: Smooth, Handwritten and Minecraft. The top bar keeps the smooth letters so it stays easy to read. Hebrew lines still show in the Hebrew font.
- **Bigger current word** (Lyrics → Lines, off at first): the word being sung grows a little, and the words next to it make room.
- **Clock in the top bar** (Display → Top bar, off at first): the time, on the left of the bar.
- The top bar no longer blinks off during instrumental parts. Between lines it shows the song's name and artist until the singing starts again.
- Help pages for players: [Questions and answers](https://github.com/arbelonson-source/belis-skylyrics/blob/main/docs/FAQ.md) and [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/arbelonson-source/belis-skylyrics/blob/main/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md).

### Better

- If LRCLIB is busy or your internet drops for a moment, the mod keeps trying while the song plays, instead of showing no lyrics until the next song.
- Smoother letter edges when the lyrics are big, and a faster top bar.
- Fixes for lyrics lookups: songs you skip quickly, unusual lyrics files, titles like "Song - Remastered 2011", and browsers that send the song's length or cover a moment late.

Install: drop the jar into your `mods` folder next to Fabric API (see the [README](https://github.com/arbelonson-source/belis-skylyrics#install)).
